notes.title: Jack Axe: The Trial Event is Live!
notes.content:
[h2]The Indie Houses Steam event is now live and we prepared a special game for you![/h2]

[previewyoutube=bi25oCVIE7M;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]Introducing Jack Axe: The Trial![/b][/u]

Jack Axe: The Trial is a [b]FREE [/b]taste of the fantasy platformer, Jack Axe. Use your magic axe and platforming skills to dash, leap, and swim to the finish line and prove yourself a legend of the Trial in this speedrunner competition. The fastest player gets their own custom character added to the game!

[list]
[*] This is a free version of Jack Axe featuring a time trial speedrun competition!
[*] Top score gets immortalized in the game with their very own character!
[*]Steam Credit for top 5 players!
[*] Interested in competing? More details in our Community - [url=https://discord.com/invite/nd]discord.gg/nd[/url]
[/list]

[u][b][h2]You can submit your entry here:
[url=https://forms.gle/soWQzQyeu6fn1NND7]Submission Form[/url][/h2][/b][/u]

[previewyoutube=-w1WTMKLG0w;full][/previewyoutube]
